name: resume-blueprint

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @resume-blueprint/core && npm run build --workspace @resume-blueprint/store && npm run build --workspace @resume-blueprint/mcp && npm run build --workspace @resume-blueprint/cli && npm run build --workspace @resume-blueprint/http
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @resume-blueprint/core && npm run test --workspace @resume-blueprint/store && npm run test --workspace @resume-blueprint/mcp && npm run test --workspace @resume-blueprint/cli && npm run test --workspace @resume-blueprint/http
scripts.typecheck:test: npm run build && npm run typecheck:test --workspace @resume-blueprint/core && npm run typecheck:test --workspace @resume-blueprint/store && npm run typecheck:test --workspace @resume-blueprint/mcp && npm run typecheck:test --workspace @resume-blueprint/cli && npm run typecheck:test --workspace @resume-blueprint/http
